article.title: 6sense公布代理式GTM更新，BDR與AI可見度功能分階段測試
article.title_en: 6sense announces agentic GTM updates with staged BDR and AI Visibility betas
article.summary: 6sense於11月3日公布新定位及產品安排，多項能力仍屬測試階段。
article.summary_en: 6sense’s November 3 announcement sets out a new positioning and staged product availability.
highlights: BDR Agent於11月推出測試版；AI Visibility計劃12月測試。
Sales Intelligence MCP已正式提供；其他能力有各自時間表。
highlights_en: BDR Agent enters beta in November; AI Visibility beta is planned for December.
Sales Intelligence MCP is generally available; other features follow separate schedules.
article.why: B2B團隊採購代理工具時，需要按功能逐項查資格，不能以整體發布代替可用性核對。
article.why_en: B2B buyers should assess eligibility feature by feature rather than treating an announcement as full availability.
article.next_step: 按現有銷售流程，列出需要的訊號、操作及人手批准點，再詢問測試資格。
article.next_step_en: List required signals, actions and approval points before asking about beta access.
article.detail: GTM指把產品帶到市場、取得客戶的工作。6sense希望把買家情報接入人員與AI代理使用的工具，BDR Agent支援初步業務開發，AI Visibility則觀察品牌在AI答案中的呈現。公告把BDR、可解釋性及AI可見度列為不同階段，並未表示全部已正式開放。Sales Intelligence MCP提供相容代理查詢接入；公司預測能力與成效仍需由使用者評估，本報未引用其買家比例或勝率數字。
article.detail_en: GTM covers bringing products to market and acquiring customers. 6sense separates BDR outreach, explainability and AI-answer visibility into different release stages. Its MCP integration exposes intelligence to compatible agents. No buyer percentages or independently proven sales gains are asserted here.
article.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
